From the third of June, a new bus will run to the airport. The number is seventy-two. Buses leave every fifteen minutes from Bridge Street. A single ticket costs four pounds fifty.

The swimming club meets on Thursday evenings at seven o'clock. New members must bring a towel and a photo. The coach is Mr Brennan, B, R, E, N, N, A, N. The first lesson is free, and after that it costs six pounds.
The weekend market moves to Park Road next month. There will be thirty stalls selling fruit, bread and cheese. It opens at nine a.m. and closes at two p.m.

The health centre has a new phone number. It is oh one six one, four nine eight, two two seven three. The centre is closed on Sunday. To see a nurse, arrive before ten o'clock. The new doctor is Dr Patel, P, A, T, E, L. Parking costs two pounds.

A cooking course starts on the twelfth of October. There are eight lessons, one each week. The course costs ninety-six pounds. Students learn to make Italian pasta and French desserts. Classes are in Room B four.
Museum tours now start at eleven a.m. Each tour lasts about ninety minutes. Children under five go free. Adults pay seven pounds. Please meet the guide at the main entrance.
You can now rent a bike near the station. It costs three pounds an hour or fifteen pounds for a full day. You need to show a passport or driving licence. The shop closes at six p.m.

The careers fair takes place on the twenty-first of March at the Hilton Hotel. More than sixty companies will attend. Entry is free, but you must register online by the eighteenth. The organiser, Mr Gorman, G, O, R, M, A, N, advises students to bring ten copies of their CV.

A new survey shows that thirty-eight per cent of workers in the city now cycle to work. Ten years ago the figure was only twelve per cent. The council plans to build twenty-five kilometres of new bike lanes by twenty twenty-eight. The project will cost four point two million pounds.

The new student flats on Carlton Avenue will be ready in September. Each flat has six bedrooms and a shared kitchen. Rent is a hundred and fifteen pounds a week, including bills. Applications close on the thirtieth of June.

This year's music festival runs for three days, from Friday the ninth of August. Over forty bands will play on four stages. A weekend ticket costs eighty-five pounds, and camping is twenty pounds extra.

Repairs on the main road will begin at ten p.m. on Tuesday. The road will be closed for five nights. Drivers should use Mill Lane instead. Buses number fourteen and 22 will also change their route. For details, call oh eight hundred, three one two, five five six.

The book club meets on the first Wednesday of every month in the café on Grove Street. This month's book is about a journey across Canada. The meeting starts at six forty-five. Members pay two pounds fifty for coffee and cake.

Tomorrow will be sunny in the morning, with temperatures reaching twenty-four degrees. In the afternoon, strong winds are expected along the coast. Rain will arrive on Saturday night. Next week, temperatures will fall to around sixteen degrees, which is four degrees below average.

The city park needs volunteers to plant five hundred trees on the fourteenth of November. Volunteers should arrive at nine fifteen and wear strong boots. Lunch is provided. To sign up, email Ms Okafor, O, K, A, F, O, R.

Researchers at the university studied two thousand four hundred teenagers. They found that students who slept less than seven hours scored eighteen per cent lower in maths tests. The lead researcher, Professor Lindqvist, L, I, N, D, Q, V, I, S, T, recommends that schools start classes after nine a.m.

The airport will open a third terminal in twenty thirty-one. It will handle twelve million passengers a year. The project costs about nine hundred million pounds, and it will create three and a half thousand jobs. Local residents are worried about noise.

Small businesses in the region grew by six point five per cent last year, the fastest rate since twenty fifteen. Most growth came from online retail. However, one in four owners said finding skilled staff was their biggest problem. The report was published on the second of May.

Your booking reference is K, T, seven, three, nine, two. You have reserved a double room for four nights, arriving on the twenty-sixth of July. The total price is four hundred and thirty-six pounds. Check-in is from three p.m.

Solar power now produces fourteen per cent of the country's electricity, up from just two per cent a decade ago. The government aims to reach forty per cent by twenty forty. The biggest solar farm is near the town of Ashford, A, S, H, F, O, R, D.

The exchange programme sends a hundred and twenty students abroad every year. Students spend five months at a partner university, usually in Japan or Australia. The grant covers flights and up to six hundred and fifty pounds a month for living costs. The deadline is the first of February.

The national park welcomed one point eight million visitors last year. To protect wildlife, the number of cars will be limited to three hundred a day from April. Visitors are encouraged to take the shuttle bus, which costs five pounds return.

A survey of eight hundred and fifty adult learners found that sixty-four per cent study a language on their phones. The most popular time to practise is between nine and ten in the evening. The most studied language after English is Spanish. The survey was carried out in December.
